headline: Sensex and Nifty End Flat as High Crude Oil Prices and Fed Caution Offset Sectoral Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: High crude oil prices hovering near USD 115 per barrel weighed on domestic market sentiment.
Caution surrounding the US Federal Reserve policy decision and selling in IT stocks restricted upside.
Banking sell-off and losses in major stock heavyweights dragged down main benchmark indices.
Indian lenders deferred dollar debt issuance plans as rising international rates made borrowing expensive.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty ended flat around 22,750 while the Midcap Index gained 565 points.
Media index jumped nearly 4% while smallcaps, pharma, realty, and consumer durables outperformed.
Bajaj Auto posted a 35% YoY rise in Q2 profit to Rs 3,354 crore on 34% revenue growth.
Cipla and Maruti Suzuki reported Q2 net profit declines of 35% and 26% YoY, respectively.
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed flat as elevated global crude prices and Fed rate caution offset gains in broader markets. Midcaps, smallcaps, pharma, and media sectors outperformed despite weakness in banking and IT shares. Corporate earnings remained mixed with Bajaj Auto reporting strong Q2 profit growth while Cipla and Maruti Suzuki faced profit declines.
